This '''skirmish''' took place in [[Darth Bane's mansion]] on [[Ciutric IV]] in [[980 BBY]]. [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Serra]], the daughter of [[Caleb]], discovered that her father had been [[Death/Legends|killed]] ten years earlier after he had [[Force healing/Legends|healed]] [[Darth Bane/Legends|Darth Bane]] for a second time. Looking for revenge, she hired the [[Iktotchi/Legends|Iktotchi]] [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] known as [[Darth Cognus|The Huntress]] to capture Bane and bring him to her, providing the Huntress with several [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] and a senior member of Serra's [[Doan Royal Guard|Royal Guard]], [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Jedder]]. They arrived at Bane's mansion shortly before the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] returned from his [[Mission to Prakith (Darth Bane)|mission to Prakith]].

As the Dark Lord entered his home, two [[Sonic grenade/Legends|sonic detonators]] set up on either side of his front door exploded, distracting him. He was then set upon by four mercenaries, whose [[Stun/Legends|stun]] shots he blocked with a [[Force barrier/Legends|Force barrier]]. Meanwhile, the Huntress began interfering with his ability to draw on [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], causing one shot to get through and hit him. He quickly recovered, shooting [[Force lightning/Legends|Force lightning]] out at the four mercenaries. However, due to the interference, his bolts only killed three; the fourth was able to throw herself back over the balcony and escape from the lightning. Five [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] then appeared and shot at him with [[tangle gun]]s.

Bane [[Force jump/Legends|leaped]] up to the ceiling, grabbing onto the chandelier and and launching himself up onto the balcony. He then confronted the Huntress, whom he realized was the one interfering with his ability to touch the Force. She charged him, distracting him long enough to prevent him from noticing the [[Flash grenade/Legends|flash grenades]] at his feet. They exploded, blinding him, and he stumbled back into the balcony railing. The Iktotchi kicked him in the chest, knocking him over the edge of the railing. He dropped his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] as he hit the floor and was instantly hit by several tangle gun shots, pinning him down to the ground. Bane then managed to break through the tangle guns' webbing with a burst of electricity, before rolling aside to avoid being stabbed by the Huntress, who had jumped down after him.

He [[Telekinesis/Legends|called]] his lightsaber back to his hand, but the Huntress retreated, making way for the mercenaries to take over the fight again. Several flash grenades exploded around him, but Bane used his ability to see through the Force, rather than using his physical sight. More webbing was shot at him, but he destroyed them before they could reach him. Several [[Concussion grenade/Legends|concussion grenades]] were then launched at him and Bane threw up another protective barrier around himself. Jedder and another soldier then jumped out and shot at him, but Bane deflected the stun bolts and crushed them against the wall behind a couch. He then quickly cut two more soldiers [[Sai tok/Legends|in half]] before jumping up back on the balcony to face the Iktotchi once more. Bane attacked her with his lightsaber and the Huntress struck back with her twin [[Knife/Legends|knives]]; both missed, however, and Bane threw her back over the balcony. She managed to land on her feet, however, and dodge the Force lightning that he then sent at her. He jumped down, dodging the soldiers' stun bolts, trying to get after the Huntress. However, at some point during the fight, the Huntress had managed to strike his forearm with one of her knives&mdash;which had been tipped with [[senflax]], a neurotoxin. As he landed, he instantly fell down, unconscious. Ordering the mercenaries to cease fire, the Huntress felt [[Darth Zannah/Legends|Darth Zannah's]] approach and arranged their escape. She took the Dark Lord's lightsaber and they returned to the [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] that would take them to [[Doan]].
